subject.title: fix(canvas): stop sending undefined coords on partial placement

question: Should Canvas accept partial placement records, or should the tool reject, omit, or normalize them before invoking the Canvas node?
rationale: The existing and proposed serialized payloads are equivalent under the PR's stated JSON path, so source review cannot select the intended protocol behavior without the Canvas-node contract.

options.title: Define and implement partial placement
options.body: Document the accepted partial-field semantics, add a node-boundary regression test, and show a real Canvas invocation with the expected rendered result.

options.title: Require complete placement
options.body: Treat incomplete coordinate sets as invalid or omit placement entirely, then document and test the resulting tool contract.

recommendation.title: Define and implement partial placement
recommendation.body: Document the accepted partial-field semantics, add a node-boundary regression test, and show a real Canvas invocation with the expected rendered result.

likelyOwner.reason: They provide the only concrete related behavior report in the supplied review context; Canvas ownership needs confirmation from area history before a final contract decision.
